description: This file provides declarations for data model parameter access API functions, including getters, setters, validation, comparison, and utility functions for different data types, as well as macros for default prefixes. It serves as an interface for interacting with data model parameters within the software project.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetPassword
methods.description: Retrieves a password string from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetUnsigned
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned integer value from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetEnum
methods.description: Retrieves an enumerated value using the provided enum table at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a date-time value from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetStringVector
methods.description: Retrieves a list of strings (vector) from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_GetIpAddr
methods.description: Retrieves an IP address from the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_SetInteger
methods.description: Sets an integer value in the data model at the specified path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidateBool
methods.description: Validates a boolean value for a request at the specified data model path.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidatePort
methods.description: Validates a port value for a request.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidateRange_Unsigned
methods.description: Validates that an unsigned value falls within the specified range.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidateRange_Signed
methods.description: Validates that a signed integer falls within the specified range.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidateReference
methods.description: Validates a reference value against a specified table and instance.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_ValidateIpAddr
methods.description: Validates an IP address value for a request.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_CompareString
methods.description: Compares two string values with the specified operator.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_CompareNumber
methods.description: Compares two numeric string values with the specified operator.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_CompareBool
methods.description: Compares two boolean string values with the specified operator.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_CompareDateTime
methods.description: Compares two date-time string values with the specified operator.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_RestartAsyncOperation
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous restart operation for a specific data model instance.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_DontRestartAsyncOperation
methods.description: Marks an asynchronous operation to not restart.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_PopulateAliasParam
methods.description: Populates a buffer with the default alias prefix for a data model request.

methods.name: DM_ACCESS_PopulateEndpointIDParam
methods.description: Populates a buffer with the default EndpointID prefix for a data model request.
